# G010 synthetic production qualification

This directory is test evidence, excluded from canonical discovery. It does not
migrate real sources or change operational authority. Research 185 prospectively
defines its production input semantics; Specification 028 remains governing.

## Files

- `corpus.json`: eight independent, strictly admitted natural-owner declarations.
  Tests materialize these carriers in isolated Git repositories. The main
  repository's live sources and compatibility surfaces are never rewritten.
- `current_state_core.v1.schema.json`: frozen output contract. All object shapes
  are closed; state, identifier, branch and commit types are explicit.
- `expected_core.json`: exact 1,421-byte canonical fixture output; qualification
  asserts byte equality independently of the production projection.
- `crosswalk.json`: qualification-only mapping of all 23 Research 157 items.
  Fifteen map to core fields. Eight retain exact historical owner/evidence
  bindings and recoverable values outside the compact core.

## Representation and code reuse

The research script is reference evidence only: no production import, execution,
or extraction code is reused. Its historical fixture/oracle remain byte-identical.
The projection is reimplemented as restricted pure functions behind the accepted
G009 builder. No production code reads this directory or the historical oracle.

Stage, specification, resume-target and procedure representations are strengthened
to authored semantic identities. Their crosswalk is explicit test evidence;
production never parses identifiers or carrier names to reconstruct old values.
Stage, resume-target and procedure sources are independently present in the corpus
and must resolve uniquely. The current-boundary and milestone identifiers denote
authored controls, not carrier paths or independent source requirements.

## Production contract

The core contains `schema_version`, `active_workstream`, `integration_boundary`,
`current_specification`, `current_experiment`, and `paused_workstreams`.
The active owner must provide objective, execution anchor and stage. Every paused
resumable owner contributes its semantic identity, state and resume target. The
optional governing-procedure and orientation-milestone controls are projected only
when that workstream naturally owns them; a projected governing-procedure identity
must resolve to one canonical `governing_procedure.v1` source. Schema-optional
controls required by the active/core singular roles still fail visibly when absent.

Required singular roles are selected by Research 185's profile/kind/state rules.
Missing or multiple owners fail; no path, ID ordering, timestamp or first-match
choice resolves ambiguity. All paused owners with explicit `expected_to_resume`
true participate. Workstream IDs and milestone IDs determine presentation order
only. Milestone IDs must be unique even when states differ.

`current_state_core_specification()` declares `current_state_core.v1` and
`canonical_json.v1`, the same explicit 25-file generation closure as the source
inventory, and the complete canonical selector. Restricted helpers implement
cardinality, required-field projection, reference resolution and paused summaries.
The only new deterministic capability raises existing view diagnostics.

Unrelated canonical inputs cannot alter semantic output but can alter the exact
input manifest because they belong to the declared complete-corpus selector.
Carrier movement preserves selection/output while changing source-path bindings.
Full and selected operation use the same G009 builder and serializer. Persistent
evidence remains exact Git blob based; WORKTREE snapshots remain NON_COMMITTED.

Derived-view discovery excludes the four live compatibility surfaces even from
byte reads. Poisoned-carrier tests prove they cannot supply facts, interfere with
generation, or receive output. No generated artifact is promoted to authority.

## Review boundary

G010 implementation evidence only, pending independent acceptance. G011 onward
and W1 remain pending. Current continuity remains operational authority. No live
successor views are published; no staged/index generation is claimed.
